# TASK-002 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `61db4762c87b751740ac876f3acd4b5d5655ab9af4b34d551c3fcb54f2991643`

## Required Rules
- `backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-quality-001`: Backend changes must handle errors explicitly, bound remote/runtime calls with context deadlines, and keep `go vet` / `go test` green for touched packages when run in the project validators.
  - rule_sha256=6e013de6a3b7102799cea846e67c5c439ff3e68229e22feb883b48ebe15093c2 verifier=backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-quality-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.backend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-write-err-001`: HTTP 错误响应必须走 `writeErr` / `writeRuntimeFailure` / `writeRepoError` 且只传 `errcode` 常量；禁止旧签名 `writeErr(w, r, status, code, msg)` 或传字符串 message。
  - rule_sha256=e477dfd2db892a5bc6004823b5fa65c3a6813ae70df9b8b6d0eca5d3a725102d verifier=backend-code-quality-performance#RULE-backend-write-err-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.backend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md
- `backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-http-envelope-001`: All Console HTTP handlers must emit responses via `writeJSON` / `writeErr` with stable `code*` constants; do not call `json.NewEncoder` (or ad-hoc maps) in handlers.
  - rule_sha256=15cb5de807ea6faa91cc37f651b0fe3996e96e769466a75fae1a5a7041954ab7 verifier=backend-platform-rules#RULE-backend-http-envelope-001; artifacts=skill-execution-control-and-review.backend.design.md,skill-execution-control-and-review.md

## Acceptance Contract
| 场景ID | 测试层级 | 不得 Mock 的真实边界 | 关键断言 | 测试文件 / 用例 | 执行命令 | 状态 |
|--------|---------|--------------------|---------|----------------|---------|------|
| E-01 | integration | HTTP → handler → repo → SQLite | 跨 Pod executionId 被拒绝；无数据泄漏；错误码稳定 | `console/backend/test/skill_executions_api_test.go` | `cd console/backend && go test ./test -run SkillExecutionTrace -count=1` | failed |
| B-08 | integration | stats SQL → 查询 API | 两用户同名私有 Skill 返回两行，humanUserId 不同 | 同上 | 同上 | failed |
| RULE-backend-write-err-001 | unit | handler 错误路径 | 只传 errcode 常量 | `console/backend/internal/api` 测试 | `cd console/backend && go test ./internal/api -run TestHTTPEncoder -count=1` | verified |
